title: UnsafeBench: Benchmarking Image Safety Classifiers on Real-World and AI-Generated Images
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the effectiveness and robustness of image safety classifiers against categories like sexual content, violence, and hate speech. While it references the 'morally negative' labels used by the Q16 classifier and includes a standard section on ethical considerations regarding the handling of unsafe data, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or specific ethical/moral systems.
